name: Freight Forwarding
fullDescription:
SSVT Logistics offers comprehensive freight forwarding services covering all modes of transport — air, sea, and road. Our experienced team of freight specialists manages the entire shipping process from origin to destination, handling all documentation, regulatory requirements, and coordination with carriers and agents worldwide.

Our air freight services offer fast, reliable transport for time-critical shipments with direct access to major airlines and charter operators. Our sea freight services cover full container loads (FCL), less-than-container loads (LCL), breakbulk, and roll-on/roll-off (RoRo) shipments. Our road freight capabilities connect inland origins and destinations with ports and air terminals across the region.

With our global network of agents and partners, we provide seamless door-to-door services for clients importing or exporting to any destination worldwide. Our digital freight management platform provides real-time visibility of all shipments from booking through delivery.
